name: date_bin_days
query: SELECT DISTINCT date, date_bin('7 days', date, 2015-01-05) AS week, date_bin('10 days', date, 2016-12-31) AS backwards, date_bin('1 day', date, 2000-01-01) AS day WHERE account = 'Expenses:Food:Groceries' AND date >= 2016-01-01 AND date < 2016-03-01 ORDER BY date
notes: A stride of days bins by whole strides from the origin, in both directions, and a date on a boundary starts its own bin (unlike strides of months).
